objective: REPLACE_WITH_ONE_PARAGRAPH_STATING_WHAT_THIS_PLAN_VERIFIES_IN_BUSINESS_LANGUAGE. Say plainly that each scenario asserts only what its approved acceptance criterion asserts.

outOfScope: REPLACE_WITH_EVERY_DEFERRED_AC_AND_WHY_IT_IS_NOT_COVERED. Naming these is what stops a green run being read as full requirement coverage.

scenarios.title: REPLACE_WITH_BUSINESS_LANGUAGE_TITLE_NO_SELECTORS_NO_PAGE_OBJECT_NAMES
scenarios.expectedResult: REPLACE_WITH_WHAT_MUST_BE_TRUE_AFTERWARDS. Assert only what the acceptance criterion asserts; never a message string that has not been approved.
testDataRequirements: REPLACE_WITH_THE_DATA_NEEDED. A negative credential path uses fabricated values from test-data/<capability>.sample.json, never the real account.
scenarios.interfaceType: REPLACE_WITH_UI_OR_API_OR_HYBRID. Absence means UI. API and HYBRID additionally require an apiContract, and an endpoint, field name or status code is never authored by an agent.

notes: REPLACE_WITH_ANYTHING_A_RUNNER_MUST_KNOW. State whether any scenario changes application data.

entryCriteria: REPLACE_WITH_WHAT_MUST_BE_TRUE_BEFORE_THIS_PLAN_CAN_RUN. Gate 1 evidence is always one of them.
exitCriteria: REPLACE_WITH_WHAT_MUST_BE_TRUE_FOR_THE_PLAN_TO_BE_DONE. Include that no DEFERRED acceptance criterion is mapped to a scenario, and that no result is recorded without a real execution record.

clarifications.question: REPLACE_WITH_THE_QUESTION_PUT_TO_THE_HUMAN. A testing judgement the story does not state - such as declaring every scenario UI - belongs here rather than being settled silently.
